events.title: SAR observation received
events.description: Sentinel-1 SAR pass detected a vessel-sized radar return near the predicted track, approximately 50 minutes after AIS loss.

data.source: Simulated Sentinel-1 SAR pass (synthetic demo detection)

events.title: No reliable AIS correlation found
events.description: MARINT compared the SAR detection against all active and recently-lost AIS tracks in the area. No vessel matched within tolerance.

events.description: Mazandaran departed Amirabad bound for Bandar Anzali.

events.title: Optical observation received
events.description: A subsequent Sentinel-2 optical pass, under clear-sky conditions, imaged a vessel-shaped object close to the SAR detection position, independently corroborating it.

data.source: Simulated Sentinel-2 optical pass (synthetic demo detection)

events.title: Possible dark vessel alert generated
events.description: Detection flagged as a possible dark vessel: AIS gap on Serdar's known corridor coincides with an uncorrelated SAR return, independently corroborated by a Sentinel-2 optical pass, near the predicted position.

events.title: Unexpected route deviation detected
events.description: Xezer diverged sharply from the established Alat–Aktau corridor and has not resumed course toward its filed destination.

events.title: Vessels converged offshore
events.description: Neft Dashlari and Khazar Servis closed to within approximately 150 m of each other near the ACG offshore field and held station.

events.title: Activity inside ACG Offshore Security Zone
events.description: The rendezvous occurred inside the ACG Offshore Security Zone, a designated offshore security zone — both vessels' presence there is being tracked accordingly.

events.title: Possible ship-to-ship activity concluded
events.description: After remaining in close proximity for approximately 1.5 hours, the two vessels resumed independent movement.

events.title: Arrived Bandar Anzali
events.description: Shirvan arrived at Bandar Anzali and is now moored.
